title: Numerical Study of Eigenvector Deflation to Accelerate the WaveHoltz Method
summary: We present a numerical study of eigenvector deflation as a means of accelerating the WaveHoltz method for solving the Helmholtz equation. For energy-conserving (Dirichlet or Neumann) boundary conditions the WaveHoltz fixed-point iteration converges slowly at high frequency, requiring approximately $\mathcal{O}(ω^{2d})$ iterations in $d$ dimensions.
